items.name: Custom Mix Dye Coupon
items.description:
A special dye coupon that allows you to mix one of the 8 base colors with one of 8 mix colors in any ratio you want, and dye your hair a beautiful, unique hue. The new mixed dye color will remain even if you acquire a new hairstyle.

Take this to the Hair Salon in Town to use.

items.name: Signature Face Coupon

items.name: Custom Colorblend Eye Color Coupon
items.description:
Use this special coupon to change your eye color. Choose a base color and an additional color to mix in any ratio you want to create a truly unique look!

Take this to the Plastic Surgery in Town to use.

items.name: Signature Skin Color Coupon
items.description: Take this to Henesys Skin-Care to change your skin to a color of your choice. (One-Time Use)

items.name: Pet Name Tag
items.description:
Use this item to name your pet. If you say its name before giving it a command, your pet will respond much better to your orders. 
Example: Lucky, sit! 
Only letters and numbers can be used in names, and only 1 blank space is allowed in the text of the name.

items.name: Water of Life
items.description: Mysterious water gathered from the deepest valleys of Ellinia. Use it to extend a living pet's active time, or bring it to Mar the fairy in Ellinia to restore a pet that has turned into a doll.

items.name: Brown Kitty
items.description: They are quiet and gentle in nature, so they don't get hungry easily. They don't seem to be too obedient to their owners.

items.name: Brown Puppy
items.description: They are outgoing and active in nature, so they can't sit still for a period of time and get hungry often. They are very obedient to their owners.

items.name: Pink Bunny
items.description: They are well-behaved and quiet, so they eat the usual amount. They are smart and obedient, but also stubborn.

items.name: Mini Kargo
items.description: They are very, very active, so they get hungry pretty often. Very intelligent, they are quite obedient to their owners.

items.name: Black Kitty
items.description: They are quiet and gentle in nature, so they don't get hungry easily. They don't seem to be too obedient to their owners.

items.name: White Bunny
items.description: They are well-behaved and quiet, so they eat the usual amount. They are smart and obedient, but also stubborn.

items.name: Husky
items.description: Active, yet calm at times. Eats a moderate amount of food. Very smart overall.

items.name: Black Pig
items.description: Very active and hungry at all times. Needs to be fed often. Very friendly in nature, so it's easy to increase closeness with them.

items.name: Panda
items.description: Calm, relaxed, and gentle. A very rare creature.

items.name: Dino Boy
items.description: A very adorable, male baby dinosaur that is both active and unpredictable.

items.name: Dino Girl
items.description: A very adorable, female baby dinosaur that is both active and unpredictable.

items.name: Snail
items.description: A snail that is really hard to figure out. The pet's skills will disappear once its magic runs out.

items.name: Auto HP Potion Skill
items.description:
Allows your pet to use your HP potions on you when your HP falls below the threshold that you set. 
Can be used on all pets that do not have this skill.

items.name: Auto MP Potion Skill
items.description:
Allows your pet to use your MP potions on you when your MP falls below the threshold that you set.
Can be used on all pets that do not have this skill.

items.name: Auto Move Skill
items.description:
Adds a skill that allows your pet to automatically pick up nearby items and mesos without you having to move.
Can be used on pets with Meso Magnet or Item Pouch.

items.name: Expanded Auto Move Skill
items.description:
Triples your pet's auto move distance.
Can only be used on pets with the Auto Move Skill. Cannot be stacked.

items.name: AP Reset Scroll
items.description: Resets all stats, including AP invested in HP/MP.

items.name: SP Reset Scroll
items.description: When used, resets all skills except for beginner skills.

items.name: Regular Store Permit
items.description:
Allows you to open a regular store in which you can list up to 16 items at once. Can be used in fields or the Free Market.
If you are attacked or killed by a monster, the store will close.

items.name: Summer Store Permit
items.description:
This special-edition coupon allows you to open a sky-blue tree store in which you can list up to 24 items at once. Can be used in fields or the Free Market. Available for a limited time only.
If you are attacked or killed by a monster, the store will close.

items.name: Pink Store Permit
items.description:

items.name: Shadow Style
items.description: Traces of the character remain when the character moves, creating multiple images of the character in the process. Double-click on the icon or designate a Hotkey via KeyConfig to toggle the effect on/off.
